description_en: Changes an existing cloud computer policy for cloud computers
description_zh: 为云电脑更换绑定的云电脑策略
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-desktops-policy-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-id ecd-ia2zw38bi6cm70000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDesktopsPolicyGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) operation to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service (EDS)
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cloud computer policy that you want to associate with cloud computers.

If the `PolicyGroupIds` parameter is used, ignore the current parameter
parameters.help_zh:
需要绑定的云电脑策略ID。

如果传入参数`PolicyGroupIds`，则此参数将被忽略
parameters.name: policy_group_id

parameters.help_en: The cloud computer IDs. You can specify one or more cloud computers IDs. The value is a JSON array
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑ID。可设置一个或者多个，格式为JSON数组
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the cloud computer policies that you want to associate with cloud computers.

You can specify up to one cloud computer policy that takes effect globally, and up to four cloud computer policies that apply to specific IP addresses. If you specify more than one cloud computer policy that takes effect globally, only the policy first associate with the cloud computer can take effect
parameters.help_zh:
需要绑定的云电脑策略ID列表。

最多可以填写1条全局生效的云电脑策略和4条针对指定IP生效的云电脑策略。如果填写的全局生效的云电脑策略超过1条，则仅第1条生效
parameters.name: policy_group_ids

Code.description_en: The returned message. If the request was successful, `success` is returned. If the request failed, an error message is returned
Code.description_zh: 修改结果。返回`success`表示成功，否则将返回错误信息

Message.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed. This parameter is not returned if the value of Code is success.``
Message.description_zh: 错误信息。当Code为`success`时，不返回该参数
Message.example: The specified param DesktopId ecd-ia2zw38bi6cm7**** is not found.
